title: Martin Romualdez’s co-accused surrenders to NBI
summary: Felicito Guevarra faces a plunder case alongside Martin Romualdez

blocks.text: SURRENDER. Samchan President Felicito Guevarra surrenders to the National Bureau of Investigation on Thursday, November 19, 2026.

items: Felicito Guevarra, president of Samchan Foreign Exchange Corporation, surrendered to the NBI on November 19, 2026, as part of a plunder case involving former House speaker Martin Romualdez.
Guevarra was granted conditional immunity by the Office of the Ombudsman in exchange for his testimony, which is expected to aid in the prosecution's case against him and other co-accused.

MANILA, Philippines – One of the co-accused of former House speaker Martin Romualdez has surrendered to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), the bureau said on Friday, November 20.

The NBI said Samchan Foreign Exchange Corporation president Felicito Guevarra surrendered the day before on November 19. Through his counsel, the accused, who faces a plunder case alongside Romualdez, relayed his plan to surrender.
“On 19 November 2026, at approximately 9:00 am, NBI agents proceeded to the agreed meeting place at Santuario de San Antonio Parish, 3117 McKinley Road, Forbes Park, Makati City,” said the NBI.
“At approximately 10:00 am, Guevarra voluntarily submitted to NBI custody in the presence of his counsel,” it added.
Guevarra was read his rights during the surrender and was later brought to the NBI headquarters to undergo standard booking procedures for arrested or surrendered suspects.
On Friday, NBI agents returned the warrant to the anti-graft court Sandiganbayan and presented Guevarra before the 3rd Division, where their case is pending.

Guevarra surrendered after the Office of the Ombudsman moved to cancel his passport. The investigative body said it granted the Samchan president conditional immunity because they will use his testimony to further strengthen their case.

“The Office granted Mr. Guevarra conditional immunity under Section 17 of Republic Act No. 6770 because his testimony and records are necessary to establish the truth in this case. The immunity rests on his full and truthful testimony,” the Ombudsman said.

“Mr. Guevarra personally handled Samchan’s operations. His testimony and records will help the prosecution trace the movement of funds alleged in the charge sheet. The charges against the other accused stand as filed,” it added.
If Guevarra breaks any condition, the Ombudsman said it will revoke the immunity. The conditions are as follows:

items: cooperate fully and truthfully with the prosecution
turn over all of Samchan’s records and devices
stay under the Department of Justice’s protection

blocks.text: Romualdez, Guevarra, former Ako Bicol representative Zaldy Co, and Josely Serenio are facing plunder, a non-bailable offense, due to alleged P7.44 billion in kickbacks from government projects.
The Ombudsman filed the plunder charge against them with the Sandiganbayan on September 7. On the same day, the 3rd Division issued a warrant of arrest against the accused.
Romualdez was subsequently arrested and has been detained in the New Quezon City Jail in Payatas since September 14. But his co-accused remained at large, until Guevarra’s surrender. – Rappler.com
